narratives.headline: Three-game slate, five thin props, all Pass-grade: a night to keep stakes small and wait on the Cunningham and Washington tags
narratives.briefing: It is a light 3-game night and the board is thin: all five props are unders and every one grades Pass on conviction, with the top card at 31. The model is not out ahead of the market anywhere big; most cards sit within a few points of DraftKings, and the best simulation gaps are the Cade Cunningham assists under (sim 68%) and the Jayson Tatum points under (sim 58%). The market has already moved toward us on AJ Dybantsa (16.5 to 15.5), and over the season closing lines have moved toward the morning picks 23 times against 9, but the morning record itself is 13-21-0 (-9.08u), so treat these as small paper positions, not conviction plays. Yesterday was a good day (morning 3-2-0, +1.11u), which does not change the longer record. Injury reports are not final: we are waiting on Cade Cunningham (Probable) and P.J. Washington (Questionable), and a Cunningham change would hit both Detroit-Orlando cards.

We are wrong if he plays long minutes (his overs came at 39.2 minutes) or if the recent ORL pattern holds, only 4 of 12 under 8.5; and he is listed Probable, so the bet is off if he sits.

narratives.briefing: The board has turned over since the morning edition: Jalen Suggs Under 10.5 joined at 17:30Z as the highest-conviction card at 32, Trae Young is back on, and Jayson Tatum, Payton Pritchard, Cooper Flagg and Cade Cunningham's assists under have all been removed as no longer +EV. Of the cards still standing, Wendell Carter Jr. Under 10.5 is the only one holding at its play-to price, now +102 after opening the day at −110; Suggs, AJ Dybantsa, Aaron Gordon and Trae Young have all moved past their play-to numbers, so they are not adds at current prices. Every card is rated Pass by conviction, and the record argues for small, careful action: the morning report is 13-21-0 (-9.08u) and game lines are 20-43 (-25.05u). On leans, WSH +10.5 came and went when the number moved to 11.5, the BOS @ WSH over is back at 218.5, and DET -2.5 improved to −105 but is past its play-to. Official reports this morning list Cade Cunningham probable (knee), Duncan Robinson, Jalen Duren and Paolo Banchero out, and P.J. Washington questionable with illness; Cunningham's and Washington's final calls are the news to wait on before tip.

narratives.headline: Final: Cunningham ruled out, Washington a game-time call, and every prop left on the card is now past its play-to price
narratives.briefing: It is a thin 3-game Tuesday, and the late news landed on two of them: Detroit ruled Cade Cunningham out after he had been probable, and Dallas still lists P.J. Washington as questionable with an illness after he took part in shootaround. Five props remain on the card (Desmond Bane, Wendell Carter Jr., Cooper Flagg, DeMar DeRozan and Neemias Queta), all graded Pass at conviction 28 to 31, and every one is priced past its play-to line tonight, so none of them is a good add at the current number. The market spent the afternoon moving against the card: Payton Pritchard and Kyshawn George came off in the last run, AJ Dybantsa, Jalen Suggs, Trae Young, Jayson Tatum, Aaron Gordon, Daniel Gafford and Cade Cunningham's assists under were all removed earlier as their lines moved away. The record argues for restraint as well: the final edition is 15-20-0 (-6.20u), the morning 13-21-0 (-9.08u), and game lines are 20-43 (-25.05u) since 2026-11-11, even after a 3-2-0 day yesterday. What could still change before tip is Washington's status, which the model has not priced in yet and which touches the Flagg card most directly.

cards.p|5041939|pts|Under: The simulation has him under in 64% of games with a 22.8 projection and room to spare (under 22.5 in 6 of his last 10). What makes it wrong is DEN being the #2 softest team on small forwards and more minutes: he goes over when he plays long, and a Washington absence would push minutes and shots his way. At −104 it is past the +103 play-to, and Washington's status is the deciding news.
